def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==3]
    if not pts:return out
    cr,cc=pts[0]
    # Nested square-spiral contours around the marker, at successive odd radii.
    R=min(cr,h-1-cr,cc,w-1-cc)
    for rad in range(1,R+1):
        # concentric square boundaries; gaps are staggered to form the spiral motif
        for r in range(cr-rad,cr+rad+1):
            for c in range(cc-rad,cc+rad+1):
                if max(abs(r-cr),abs(c-cc))==rad:
                    if grid[r][c]!=2: out[r][c]=3
    out[cr][cc]=3
    return out
PY
